about_the_game:
SHAKE is the newest arena shooter on the block.

Inspired by classic multiplayer games like Super Smash Bros. and Quake, SHAKE is all about movement and staying on the map. Everyone is armed with explosive weapons that deal massive knockback to opponents, and your goal is to survive and accumulate damage on your enemies to send them flying. Outmaneuver your enemies with your own movement strategies to stay on the map as long as physically possible. Only one will remain!

Each player is armed with up to 3 weapons. It is up to YOU how you use these weapons to stay on the map, as well as how you will use them to hurt and push your opponents off. Rocket jump to the sky with explosives. Send other players to the moon with a well-timed shotgun blast. The sky is literally the limit!

With SHAKE, you can expect to play with your friends on public or private servers via in-game matchmaking. Alternatively, you can boot the game in LAN mode for fast-speed local connections. Customize your character to your liking, host a game with your preferred settings, or join another player's game to jump straight into the action.

Will you be the next victor of SHAKE?

short_description: SHAKE is all about movement. In this action-packed arena shooter, up to 8 players fight to stay on the map by knocking their opponents off. Everyone is armed with multiple explosive, knockback dealing weapons you can use to send your enemies flying! Will you be the next victor of SHAKE?
